limits: Actually inspected each listed retained image via tools.view_image original detail, not every decoded frame or whole movies. Context sampling is every fourth frame plus semantic boundaries/range end.
Contact panels use shared 621x331 crops at 1:1 decoded pixel scale; off-crop actors and environment are unjudged. Viewing display may resize the contact sheet.
These are H264-decoded lossy video frames re-encoded as JPEG92 4:4:4 contact sheets, not original Godot PNG captures.
Common-death scope covers only the early roughly0.97s death response; it does not establish complete skeletal death or eventual settling. Interrupted-elite range adds only an overlapping final panel.
Dark lighting, small game-scale characters, effects and actor overlap limit anatomical, finger, attachment, weapon-contact and floor-penetration judgments.
No native bone-position validation, physical-device FPS, whole-movie human review, separate human signoff or release approval is claimed.
Commit binding uses saved completed comparison and decoder/capture provenance; Git/source content was not re-audited during this visual review.
